Asturian

[edit]
Asturian Wikipedia has an article on:
gasolina
Wikipedia ast

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ɡasoˈlina/ [ɡa.soˈli.na]
  • Rhymes: -ina
  • Syllabification: ga‧so‧li‧na

Noun

[edit]

gasolina f (uncountable)

  1. gasoline, petrol (motor fuel)

Derived terms

[edit]
  • gasolineru

Further reading

[edit]
  • “gasolina”, in Diccionariu de la llingua asturiana [Dictionary of the Asturian Language] (in Asturian), 1st edition, Academy of the Asturian Language [Asturian: Academia de la Llingua Asturiana], 2000, →ISBN

Catalan

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): (Central, Balearic) [ɡə.zuˈli.nə]
  • IPA(key): (Valencia) [ɡa.zoˈli.na]
  • Audio (Barcelona):(file)
  • Rhymes: -ina
  • Hyphenation: ga‧so‧li‧na

Noun

[edit]

gasolina f (plural gasolines)

  1. gasoline, petrol (motor fuel)

Derived terms

[edit]
  • gasolinera

Further reading

[edit]
  • “gasolina”, in Diccionari de la llengua catalana [Dictionary of the Catalan Language] (in Catalan), second edition, Institute of Catalan Studies [Catalan: Institut d'Estudis Catalans], April 2007
  • “gasolina”, in Gran Diccionari de la Llengua Catalana, Grup Enciclopèdia Catalana, 2026
  • “gasolina” in Diccionari normatiu valencià, Acadèmia Valenciana de la Llengua.
  • “gasolina” in Diccionari català-valencià-balear, Antoni Maria Alcover and Francesc de Borja Moll, 1962.

Cebuano

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • gasol

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Spanish gasolina.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ɡasoˈlina/ [ɡɐ.s̪oˈl̪i.n̪ɐ]
  • Rhymes: -ina
  • Hyphenation: ga‧so‧li‧na

Noun

[edit]

gasolína (Badlit spelling ᜄᜐᜓᜎᜒᜈ)

  1. gasoline (US, Canada); petrol (Australia, UK)

Verb

[edit]

gasolína (Badlit spelling ᜄᜐᜓᜎᜒᜈ)

  1. to refuel with gasoline/petrol; to gas up

Derived terms

[edit]
  • gasolinador (“accelerator pedal”)
  • gasolinahan (“gas station; petrol station; fuel station”)

gasolína (Basahan spelling ᜄᜐᜓᜎᜒᜈ)

Italian

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ɡa.zoˈli.na/

Portuguese

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from French gazoline, from English gasoline.

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ɡa.zuˈlĩ.nɐ/, /ɡa.zoˈlĩ.nɐ/
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ɡa.zuˈlĩ.nɐ/, /ɡa.zoˈlĩ.nɐ/
    • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /ɡa.zoˈli.na/
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ɡɐ.zuˈli.nɐ/

  • Audio (Portugal (Porto)):(file)
  • Rhymes: (Portugal) -inɐ, (most of Brazil) -ĩnɐ, (Southern Brazil) -ina
  • Hyphenation: ga‧so‧li‧na

Noun

[edit]

gasolina f (plural gasolinas)

  1. petrol / gasoline
    Synonym: benzina

Derived terms

[edit]
  • gasolineira

Further reading

[edit]
  • “gasolina”, in Dicionário Aulete Digital (in Portuguese), Rio de Janeiro: Lexikon Editora Digital, 2008–2026
  • “gasolina”, in Dicionário Priberam da Língua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), Lisbon: Priberam, 2008–2026

Spanish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from English gasoline.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ɡasoˈlina/ [ɡa.soˈli.na]
  • Audio (Colombia):(file)
  • Rhymes: -ina
  • Syllabification: ga‧so‧li‧na

Noun

[edit]

gasolina f (plural gasolinas)

  1. petrol, gasoline
    Synonyms: (Chile, Peru) bencina, (Argentina, Paraguay, Uruguay) nafta, gasofa

Derived terms

[edit]
  • gasolinera
  • gasolinero

Descendants

[edit]
  • → Central Bikol: gasolina
  • → Cebuano: gasolina
  • → Hiligaynon: gasolina
  • → Tagalog: gasolina
  • → Zoogocho Zapotec: gasolin

Further reading

[edit]
  • “gasolina”, in Diccionario de la lengua española [Dictionary of the Spanish Language] (in Spanish), online version 23.8.1, Royal Spanish Academy [Spanish: Real Academia Española], 15 December 2025
